label: Microwave II/XT ROM
description: Xenia needs the firmware of your own Waldorf Microwave II or XT: the 256 KB image, or its two 128 KB halves (the lower and upper chips).
hint: Any file names work. An OS update .mid can go next to a full ROM: the highest version runs.

rules.label: Microwave XT OS update (.mid)
rules.note: Looks like a Microwave XT OS update. It is used only next to a full ROM; the plugin checks it when it loads.

label: Microwave XT sound banks
description: Optional: your own Microwave XT sound banks as SysEx (.syx) or MIDI (.mid) files. Each one appears as a bank after ROM banks A and B.
hint: Single-sound and all-sounds dumps both work; subfolders are fine.

rules.label: MIDI file with SysEx dumps
rules.note: Xenia uses only the Microwave XT sound dumps inside it; it checks them when it loads.
